children: climbed 1.1% in Friday's trading as D.A. Davidson upgraded the building materials company to Buy from Neutral with a $610 price target, saying the Lhoist North American acquisition lowers revenue and margin cyclicality, helping support valuation after theshares have underperformed YTD.

D.A. Davidson analyst Garik Shmois said he sees an attractive entry point for investors ahead of Q3 earnings and anticipated guidance for at least mid-single-digit to high-single-digit pricing in FY 2027, with upside potential as recent mix headwinds from NFS and Quikrete roll off.

High mid-single-digit to high-single-digit pricing should help price-cost spreads return to normal levels, assuming diesel prices remain flat and the company continues to execute on its plant automation and network optimization program, the analyst said.
Shmois also praised the combination with Lhoist North America that makes Martin Marietta

the top U.S. producer of limestone products, saying it provides greater end-market diversity, optionality to capture value from construction aggregates currently sold by third parties at LNA sites, and a more stable margin profile through energy hedges.

title: Martin Marietta raised to Buy at D.A. Davidson after YTD underperformance
